name: ATT&CK Technique Frequency - Threat Group Usage
description: The 498 ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 techniques used by at least one tracked threat group, colored by the number of groups observed using them. High-frequency techniques are the most broadly adopted adversary behaviors and are strong candidates for detection and mitigation investment. Revoked ids are excluded (their usage counts under the live successor). Source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 group-to-technique relationships. Generated by scripts/build_priority_gaps.py.
